bio: In the beautiful building of the Casino Bern, which opened in 1909 in the centre of the old town, the mixture of a great historical setting and brasserie chic exudes a special flair, which continues in summer on the wonderful large terrace - here you can enjoy the view of the Aare under shady trees. The menu features classic dishes as well as Italian influences. There is a menu (also vegetarian) as well as an a la carte offer in addition to ‘Grosses pièces’ for two people. Next to the restaurant is the ‘Salon d'Or’ with bistro bar - here you can enjoy coffee and cake as well as wines and cocktails throughout the day....
